title: Transport Response Schema Migration 1048 Governed Rollout

phases.objective: Validate the repository-governed readiness, exactly-once apply, and readback control plane for Migration 1048 without executing SQL, reading secrets, or mutating Production during CI.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact pull-request head contains the Migration 1048 rollout runner, workflow, regression test, and this phase contract.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The control plane proves checksum/blob-bound readiness, explicit authorization, exactly-once Apply semantics with no retry, and verification by ledger/readback while CI itself performs no migration or external mutation.
steps: Read the Migration 1048 governed rollout runner and workflow from the exact pull-request head.
Execute the repository regression that checks command bindings, Production provenance guards, dry-run gating, single Apply dispatch, no retry behavior, and Verify-only reconciliation.
Record repository evidence only; do not execute Migration 1048, connect to a live database for mutation, read credentials or secrets, call a provider, deploy, or mutate Production.
assertions: Readiness is bound to the live Production SHA, Migration 1048 path, expected blob SHA, exact checksum, and statement count before Apply can become eligible.
Apply requires explicit readiness evidence and contains exactly one governed migration execution path with no automatic retry.
Verify performs ledger/readback reconciliation without sending Apply.
CI performs no SQL mutation, migration Apply, provider call, credential or secret access, deployment, Production mutation, external send, or force update.
